title: spergularia rubra subsp. media
intro: Spergularia rubra subsp. media, commonly known as the Red Sandwort, is a species of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is native to Europe and Western Asia and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Spergularia rubra subsp. media include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be used to treat various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and act as a diuretic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
